dedupe_keys.name: artesp sao paulo transport agency open data state highway concessions

description: ARTESP, the transport agency of the State of São Paulo, regulates and supervises delegated transport infrastructure and services: state highway concessions, intercity buses, and airport, metro-rail and ferry concessions. Its open data portal holds 47 datasets, among them the network of conceded state highways with authorised and unauthorised accesses (KMZ files per concession and spreadsheets), the register of assets, accidents and incidents, traffic volumes, tolls, programmed works, messages shown on variable message signs, equipment availability, fire hotspots near highways, digital engineering (BIM) files, GTFS feeds for intercity buses, highway technical standards and concession contracts. Coverage is regional: the state of São Paulo. The portal runs on CKAN with an API, and datasets are free under a Creative Commons Attribution licence as XLSX, KMZ, CSV and other files; the road network dataset was updated in September 2026. Caveats: only conceded state highways are covered, and ARTESP's organisation on the portal dates from May 2025, so some series are short. The network, assets and traffic data support network flow and capacity planning models, and accidents and fire hotspots support hazard exposure and resilience studies. It complements the federal ANTT open data.
